scripts.script:
-- Credits to tennisballs9000 on discord, dm me for suggestions
-- ==========================================
-- 1. RE-EXECUTION, UNLOAD & OLD UI CLEANUP
-- ==========================================
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local StatsService = game:GetService("Stats")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Mouse = LocalPlayer:GetMouse()

-- Cache true original game settings on FIRST execution only
if _G.OriginalLighting == nil then
    _G.OriginalLighting = {
        Brightness = Lighting.Brightness,
        Ambient = Lighting.Ambient,
        GlobalShadows = Lighting.GlobalShadows,
        FogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd,
        FogStart = Lighting.FogStart,
    }
end
if _G.OriginalGravity == nil then _G.OriginalGravity = workspace.Gravity end
if _G.OriginalCameraMaxZoom == nil then _G.OriginalCameraMaxZoom = LocalPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance end
if _G.OriginalFallenPartsDestroyHeight == nil then _G.OriginalFallenPartsDestroyHeight = workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight end

local function getSafeGuiContainer()
    if typeof(gethui) == "function" then
        local success, result = pcall(gethui)
        if success and result then return result end
    end
    local success, coreGui = pcall(function() return game:GetService("CoreGui") end)
    if success and coreGui then return coreGui end
    return LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

local SafeGuiContainer = getSafeGuiContainer()

local function purgeOldUI()
    local targets = {SafeGuiContainer}
    pcall(function() table.insert(targets, game:GetService("CoreGui")) end)
    pcall(function() table.insert(targets, LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")) end)

    for _, container in ipairs(targets) do
        if container then
            for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
                if child:IsA("ScreenGui") and (
                    child.Name:lower():find("linoria") or 
                    child.Name:lower():find("universal") or 
                    child:FindFirstChild("Main") or 
                    child:FindFirstChild("ResizeGripHandle") or
                    child:FindFirstChild("Screen")
                ) then
                    pcall(function() child:Destroy() end)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

-- If script was already executed, trigger full cleanup & unload LinoriaLib
if _G.UniversalHubCleanup then
    pcall(_G.UniversalHubCleanup)
end
if _G.UniversalHubLibrary then
    pcall(function() _G.UniversalHubLibrary:Unload() end)
    _G.UniversalHubLibrary = nil
end
purgeOldUI()

local connections = {}
local activeLoops = {true}

Lighting.GlobalShadows = true

-- Spectate Tracer Variables
local spectateBeam = nil
local spectateAtt0 = nil
local spectateAtt1 = nil

local function removeSpectateTracer()
    if spectateBeam then pcall(function() spectateBeam:Destroy() end) spectateBeam = nil end
    if spectateAtt0 then pcall(function() spectateAtt0:Destroy() end) spectateAtt0 = nil end
    if spectateAtt1 then pcall(function() spectateAtt1:Destroy() end) spectateAtt1 = nil end
end

-- Custom Highlight Containers
local customHighlightFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
customHighlightFolder.Name = "UniversalHub_CustomHighlights"
customHighlightFolder.Parent = workspace

local playerHighlights = {}
local npcHighlights = {}

local function clearAllCustomHighlights()
    if customHighlightFolder then
        customHighlightFolder:ClearAllChildren()
    end
    table.clear(playerHighlights)
    table.clear(npcHighlights)
end

_G.UniversalHubCleanup = function()
    activeLoops[1] = false
    
    for _, conn in ipairs(connections) do
        if conn and conn.Connected then
            conn:Disconnect()
        end
    end
    table.clear(connections)

    removeSpectateTracer()
    clearAllCustomHighlights()

    if customHighlightFolder then customHighlightFolder:Destroy() end

    if workspace:FindFirstChild("UniversalFloatPlatform") then
        workspace.UniversalFloatPlatform:Destroy()
    end

    -- Reset Camera State
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if cam then
        cam.FieldOfView = 70
        if LocalPlayer.Character then
            local hum = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local hrp = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hum then cam.CameraSubject = hum elseif hrp then cam.CameraSubject = hrp end
        end
        cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
    end

    -- Reset Character Physics & Stats to Default
    if LocalPlayer.Character then
        local hum = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then
            hum.WalkSpeed = 16
            hum.JumpPower = 50
            hum.UseJumpPower = true
            hum.MaxSlopeAngle = 45
        end
    end

    -- Restore Game Environment Settings
    if _G.OriginalLighting then
        Lighting.Brightness = _G.OriginalLighting.Brightness
        Lighting.Ambient = _G.OriginalLighting.Ambient
        Lighting.GlobalShadows = _G.OriginalLighting.GlobalShadows
        Lighting.FogEnd = _G.OriginalLighting.FogEnd
        Lighting.FogStart = _G.OriginalLighting.FogStart
    end

    if _G.OriginalGravity ~= nil then workspace.Gravity = _G.OriginalGravity end
    if _G.OriginalFallenPartsDestroyHeight ~= nil then workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = _G.OriginalFallenPartsDestroyHeight end
    if _G.OriginalCameraMaxZoom ~= nil then LocalPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance = _G.OriginalCameraMaxZoom end

    -- Unload Linoria Library Instance
    if _G.UniversalHubLibrary then
        pcall(function() _G.UniversalHubLibrary:Unload() end)
        _G.UniversalHubLibrary = nil
    end

    purgeOldUI()
end

-- ==========================================
-- 2. EXECUTOR DETECTION & TELEMETRY SYSTEM
-- ==========================================
local executorName = "Unknown"
pcall(function()
    if identifyexecutor then
        executorName = identifyexecutor()
    elseif getexecutorname then
        executorName = getexecutorname()
    end
end)

local telemetryData = {
    Enabled = true,
    PlaceId = game.PlaceId,
    GameId = game.GameId,
    GameName = "Unknown",
    Executor = executorName,
    SessionStart = os.time(),
    FeatureUsage = {}
}

task.spawn(function()
    pcall(function()
        local info = MarketplaceService:GetProductInfo(game.PlaceId)
        if info and info.Name then
            telemetryData.GameName = info.Name
        end
    end)
end)

local function trackFeature(featureName)
    if not telemetryData.Enabled then return end
    telemetryData.FeatureUsage[featureName] = (telemetryData.FeatureUsage[featureName] or 0) + 1
end

-- ==========================================
-- 3. CORE VARIABLES & STATE
-- ==========================================
local walkSpeedValue = 16
local jumpPowerValue = 50
local fovValue = 70

local customCameraZoomEnabled = true
local customCameraZoomValue = 1280

local tpToolEnabled = false
local floatEnabled = false
local qeControlEnabled = true
local floatSpeedValue = 42
local floatBaseY = nil
local floatYOffset = 0

local potatoGraphicsEnabled = false
local fullbrightEnabled = false
local noFogEnabled = false

local customGravityEnabled = false
local customGravityValue = math.floor(_G.OriginalGravity)
local disableSlidingEnabled = false

local joinLogEnabled = false
local playerJoinTimes = {}

local lowHpTrackerEnabled = false
local deathListenerEnabled = false
local deathLogs = {}
local lowHpDebounce = {}

local spectatingPlayer = nil
local selectedTpPlayer = nil

-- Latch Onto Mechanics
local latchOntoEnabled = false
local ogLatchLocation = nil
local lastLatchedTarget = nil

local waypointsList = {}
local selectedWaypointName = nil

local playerTextOffsetY = 2.5

local soundSettings = {
    LowHP = { Volume = 0.5, SoundId = "rbxassetid://4590657391" },
    PlayerLeft = { Volume = 0.5, SoundId = "rbxassetid://9114220737" },
    General = { Volume = 0.5, SoundId = "rbxassetid://9060817403" }
}

local function playCustomSound(category)
    pcall(function()
        local cfg = soundSettings[category] or soundSettings.General
        local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
        sound.SoundId = cfg.SoundId
        sound.Volume = cfg.Volume
        sound.Parent = SoundService
        sound:Play()
        game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(sound, 3)
    end)
end

local leaveNotifQueue = {}
local isProcessingLeaveQueue = false

local function processLeaveNotificationQueue(Library)
    if isProcessingLeaveQueue then return end
    isProcessingLeaveQueue = true
    task.spawn(function()
        while #leaveNotifQueue > 0 and activeLoops[1] do
            local msg = table.remove(leaveNotifQueue, 1)
            playCustomSound("PlayerLeft")
            if Library then
                Library:Notify("Player Left: " .. msg, 4)
            end
            task.wait(0.8)
        end
        isProcessingLeaveQueue = false
    end)
end

for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    playerJoinTimes[player] = tick()
end

table.insert(connections, Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    playerJoinTimes[player] = tick()
end))

local originalMaterials = {}
task.spawn(function()
    local parts = Workspace:GetDescendants()
    for i = 1, #parts do
        local part = parts[i]
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
            originalMaterials[part] = part.Material
        end
        if i % 200 == 0 then task.wait() end
    end
end)

-- ==========================================
-- 4. AUTO ERROR RECOVERY & GARBAGE CLEANER
-- ==========================================
local loopHeartbeats = {
    render = tick(),
    heartbeat = tick(),
    npcScan = tick()
}

task.spawn(function()
    while activeLoops[1] do
        task.wait(60)
        pcall(function()
            for part in pairs(originalMaterials) do
                if not part or not part.Parent then
                    originalMaterials[part] = nil
                end
            end
            for player in pairs(playerJoinTimes) do
                if not player or not player.Parent then
                    playerJoinTimes[player] = nil
                end
            end
            for player, data in pairs(playerHighlights) do
                if not player or not player.Parent then
                    if data.highlight then pcall(function() data.highlight:Destroy() end) end
                    if data.billboard then pcall(function() data.billboard:Destroy() end) end
                    playerHighlights[player] = nil
                end
            end
            for npc, data in pairs(npcHighlights) do
                if not npc or not npc.Parent then
                    if data.highlight then pcall(function() data.highlight:Destroy() end) end
                    if data.billboard then pcall(function() data.billboard:Destroy() end) end
                    npcHighlights[npc] = nil
                end
            end
            while #deathLogs > 100 do
                table.remove(deathLogs)
            end
            collectgarbage("collect")
        end)
    end
end)

task.spawn(function()
    while activeLoops[1] do
        task.wait(5)
        pcall(function()
            local now = tick()
            for name, lastTick in pairs(loopHeartbeats) do
                if now - lastTick > 10 then
                    loopHeartbeats[name] = now
                end
            end
        end)
    end
end)

local function getGameSpawnLocation()
    if LocalPlayer.RespawnLocation and LocalPlayer.RespawnLocation:IsA("BasePart") then
        return LocalPlayer.RespawnLocation.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
    end
    for _, desc in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if desc:IsA("SpawnLocation") and desc.Enabled then
            return desc.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function giveTeleportTool()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
    if not backpack or backpack:FindFirstChild("Teleport Tool") or char:FindFirstChild("Teleport Tool") then return end

    local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
    tool.Name = "Teleport Tool"
    tool.RequiresHandle = false

    tool.Activated:Connect(function()
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hrp and Mouse.Hit then
            local currentRotation = hrp.CFrame - hrp.CFrame.Position
            hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(Mouse.Hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)) * currentRotation
        end
    end)

    tool.Parent = backpack
end

local floatPlatform = nil
local function updateFloatPlatform(dt)
    if not floatEnabled then
        if floatPlatform then floatPlatform:Destroy() floatPlatform = nil end
        floatBaseY = nil
        return
    end

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

    if hrp and hum then
        local hipOffset = (hum.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15) and (hum.HipHeight + 1.2) or 3.0
        local targetY = hrp.Position.Y - hipOffset

        if not floatBaseY or math.abs(targetY - floatBaseY) > 15 then
            floatBaseY = targetY
        end

        local verticalSpeed = floatSpeedValue * dt
        if qeControlEnabled then
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.E) then
                hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, verticalSpeed, 0)
                floatBaseY = floatBaseY + verticalSpeed
            elseif UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Q) then
                hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame - Vector3.new(0, verticalSpeed, 0)
                floatBaseY = floatBaseY - verticalSpeed
            end
        end

        if not floatPlatform or not floatPlatform.Parent then
            floatPlatform = Instance.new("Part")
            floatPlatform.Name = "UniversalFloatPlatform"
            floatPlatform.Size = Vector3.new(6, 1, 6)
            floatPlatform.Anchored = true
            floatPlatform.CanCollide = true
            floatPlatform.Transparency = 0.9
            floatPlatform.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
            floatPlatform.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
            floatPlatform.Parent = Workspace
        end
        
        floatPlatform.CFrame = CFrame.new(hrp.Position.X, floatBaseY + floatYOffset, hrp.Position.Z)
    end
end

local function stopSpectating()
    spectatingPlayer = nil
    removeSpectateTracer()
    local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if cam and char then
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hum then cam.CameraSubject = hum elseif hrp then cam.CameraSubject = hrp end
        cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
    end
end

local function updateSpectateTracer()
    if not spectatingPlayer or not spectatingPlayer.Character or not LocalPlayer.Character then
        removeSpectateTracer()
        return
    end

    local myHRP = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local targetHRP = spectatingPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myHRP or not targetHRP then removeSpectateTracer() return end

    if not spectateBeam or not spectateBeam.Parent then
        removeSpectateTracer()
        
        spectateAtt0 = Instance.new("Attachment") spectateAtt0.Parent = myHRP
        spectateAtt1 = Instance.new("Attachment") spectateAtt1.Parent = targetHRP

        spectateBeam = Instance.new("Beam")
        spectateBeam.Attachment0 = spectateAtt0
        spectateBeam.Attachment1 = spectateAtt1
        spectateBeam.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 170))
        spectateBeam.Width0 = 0.08
        spectateBeam.Width1 = 0.08
        spectateBeam.FaceCamera = true
        spectateBeam.LightEmission = 1
        spectateBeam.Parent = myHRP
    else
        if spectateAtt1 and spectateAtt1.Parent ~= targetHRP then
            spectateAtt1.Parent = targetHRP
        end
    end
end

-- ==========================================
-- 5. LINORIA LIBRARY SETUP & UI ENHANCEMENTS
-- ==========================================
local repo = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/violin-suzutsuki/LinoriaLib/main/'
local Library = loadstring(game:HttpGet(repo .. 'Library.lua'))()
local ThemeManager = loadstring(game:HttpGet(repo .. 'addons/ThemeManager.lua'))()
SaveManager = loadstring(game:HttpGet(repo .. 'addons/SaveManager.lua'))()

-- Store global library reference for clean re-execution unloading
_G.UniversalHubLibrary = Library

pcall(function()
    if Library and Library.Gui then
        Library.Gui.Parent = SafeGuiContainer
    end
end)

Library.ToggleKeybind = Enum.KeyCode.RightControl

local Window = Library:CreateWindow({
    Title = 'LinoriaHeart Hub',
    Center = true,
    AutoShow = true,
    TabPadding = 8,
    MenuFadeTime = 0.2
})

pcall(function()
    if Library and Library.Gui then
        for _, desc in ipairs(Library.Gui:GetDescendants()) do
            if desc:IsA("TextLabel") then
                desc.TextWrapped = true
                desc.ClipsDescendants = true
            elseif desc:IsA("Frame") or desc:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
                desc.ClipsDescendants = true
            end
        end

        local mainFrame = Library.Gui:FindFirstChildOfClass("Frame")
        if mainFrame then
            mainFrame.ClipsDescendants = true
            
            local resizeHandle = Instance.new("Frame")
            resizeHandle.Name = "ResizeGripHandle"
            resizeHandle.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16)
            resizeHandle.Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -16)
            resizeHandle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
            resizeHandle.BorderSizePixel = 0
            resizeHandle.Active = true
            resizeHandle.ZIndex = 100
            resizeHandle.Parent = mainFrame

            local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
            corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
            corner.Parent = resizeHandle

            local isResizing = false
            local dragStart, startSize

            resizeHandle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                    isResizing = true
                    dragStart = input.Position
                    startSize = mainFrame.Size
                end
            end)

            UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
                if isResizing and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
                    local delta = input.Position - dragStart
                    local newX = math.clamp(startSize.X.Offset + delta.X, 450, 1000)
                    local newY = math.clamp(startSize.Y.Offset + delta.Y, 350, 800)
                    mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, newX, 0, newY)
                end
            end)

            UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                    isResizing = false
                end
            end)
        end
    end
end)

local Tabs = {
    Player = Window:AddTab('Local'),
    Players = Window:AddTab('Players'),
    Visuals = Window:AddTab('Visuals'),
    Utilities = Window:AddTab('Utilities'),
    Config = Window:AddTab('Config'),
    Readme = Window:AddTab('README')
}

-- ==========================================
-- 6. LOCAL PLAYER TAB
-- ==========================================
local WaypointBox = Tabs.Player:AddLeftGroupbox('Teleport & Waypoints (50 Max)')

local newWaypointName = ""
WaypointBox:AddInput('WaypointNameInput', {
    Default = '',
    Numeric = false,
    Finished = false,
    Text = 'Waypoint Name',
    Placeholder = 'e.g. Base, Secret Room...',
    Callback = function(Value) newWaypointName = Value end
})

local waypointDropdown = WaypointBox:AddDropdown('SavedWaypointsDropdown', {
    Values = {'None'},
    Default = 1,
    Multi = false,
    Text = 'Saved Waypoints List',
    Callback = function(Value) selectedWaypointName = Value end
})

local function refreshWaypointDropdown()
    local names = {}
    for _, wp in ipairs(waypointsList) do table.insert(names, wp.Name) end
    waypointDropdown:SetValues(#names > 0 and names or {'None'})
end

WaypointBox:AddButton('Save Waypoint', function()
    trackFeature("Save_Waypoint")
    local myHRP = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myHRP then return end

    if #waypointsList >= 50 then
        Library:Notify("Waypoint limit reached (Max 50)!", 3)
        return
    end

    local wpName = newWaypointName ~= "" and newWaypointName or ("Waypoint " .. (#waypointsList + 1))
    table.insert(waypointsList, { Name = wpName, CFrame = myHRP.CFrame })
    refreshWaypointDropdown()
    playCustomSound("General")
    Library:Notify("Saved Waypoint: " .. wpName, 3)
end)

WaypointBox:AddButton('Goto Selected Waypoint', function()
    trackFeature("Goto_Waypoint")
    local myHRP = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myHRP then return end

    if not selectedWaypointName or selectedWaypointName == "None" then
        Library:Notify("No valid waypoint selected in list.", 3)
        return
    end

    for _, wp in ipairs(waypointsList) do
        if wp.Name == selectedWaypointName then
            myHRP.CFrame = wp.CFrame
            playCustomSound("General")
            Library:Notify("Teleported to waypoint: " .. wp.Name, 3)
            return
        end
    end
end)

WaypointBox:AddButton('Delete Selected Waypoint', function()
    if not selectedWaypointName or selectedWaypointName == "None" then
        Library:Notify("Select a waypoint to delete.", 3)
        return
    end

    for idx, wp in ipairs(waypointsList) do
        if wp.Name == selectedWaypointName then
            table.remove(waypointsList, idx)
            refreshWaypointDropdown()
            playCustomSound("General")
            Library:Notify("Deleted waypoint: " .. wp.Name, 3)
            break
        end
    end
end)

WaypointBox:AddButton('TP to SpawnLocation', function()
    trackFeature("TP_To_Spawn")
    local spawnCF = getGameSpawnLocation()
    local myHRP = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if spawnCF and myHRP then
        myHRP.CFrame = spawnCF
        playCustomSound("General")
        Library:Notify("Teleported to game SpawnLocation.", 3)
    else
        playCustomSound("General")
        Library:Notify("No valid SpawnLocation found in game.", 3)
    end
end)

local WaypointToolsBox = Tabs.Player:AddLeftGroupbox('Position & Axis Tools')

WaypointToolsBox:AddButton('Copy CFrame Coordinates', function()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if hrp then
        local cfStr = tostring(hrp.CFrame)
        pcall(function()
            if setclipboard then setclipboard(cfStr) elseif toclipboard then toclipboard(cfStr) end
        end)
        playCustomSound("General")
        Library:Notify("CFrame Copied to Clipboard!", 3)
    end
end)

WaypointToolsBox:AddButton('Fix Character Axis (Face North)', function()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if hrp then
        hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(hrp.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0)
        playCustomSound("General")
        Library:Notify("Character aligned to face North.", 3)
    end
end)

local MovementBox = Tabs.Player:AddRightGroupbox('Movement & Modifiers')

MovementBox:AddSlider('WalkSpeedSlider', {
    Text = 'WalkSpeed', Default = 16, Min = 16, Max = 250, Rounding = 0, Compact = false,
    Callback = function(Value)
        walkSpeedValue = Value
        local hum = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then hum.WalkSpeed = Value end
    end
})

MovementBox:AddToggle('DisableSlidingToggle', {
    Text = 'Disable Sliding (Instant Stop & Turn)', Default = false,
    Callback = function(Value)
        disableSlidingEnabled = Value
        trackFeature("Disable_Sliding")
    end
})

MovementBox:AddSlider('JumpPowerSlider', {
    Text = 'JumpPower', Default = 50, Min = 50, Max = 300, Rounding = 0, Compact = false,
    Callback = function(Value)
        jumpPowerValue = Value
        local hum = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then hum.UseJumpPower = true hum.JumpPower = Value end
    end
})

MovementBox:AddToggle('GravityToggle', {
    Text = 'Gravity', Default = false,
    Callback = function(Value)
        customGravityEnabled = Value
        workspace.Gravity = Value and customGravityValue or _G.OriginalGravity
    end
})

MovementBox:AddSlider('GravitySlider', {
    Text = 'Custom Gravity', Default = math.floor(_G.OriginalGravity), Min = -196, Max = math.floor(_G.OriginalGravity * 3), Rounding = 0, Compact = false,
    Callback = function(Value)
        customGravityValue = Value
        if customGravityEnabled then workspace.Gravity = Value end

local function bindCharacterTrackers(player)
    if player == LocalPlayer then return end
    local function onCharacter(char)
        local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
        local hrp = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
        if not hum or not hrp then return end

        table.insert(connections, hum.HealthChanged:Connect(function(health)
            if lowHpTrackerEnabled and health <= 35 and health > 0 then
                if not lowHpDebounce[player] then
                    lowHpDebounce[player] = true
                    playCustomSound("LowHP")
                    Library:Notify(player.Name .. " is low! (" .. math.floor(health) .. " HP)", 4)
                end
            elseif health > 35 then
                lowHpDebounce[player] = nil
            end
        end))

        table.insert(connections, hum.Died:Connect(function()
            if deathListenerEnabled then
                local timeStr = os.date("%I:%M:%S %p")
                local voidThreshold = (_G.OriginalFallenPartsDestroyHeight or -500) + 50
                local isVoidDeath = hrp.Position.Y <= voidThreshold

                local label = isVoidDeath and string.format("%s VOID [%s]", player.Name, timeStr) or string.format("%s Died [%s]", player.Name, timeStr)

                playCustomSound("General")
                Library:Notify(label, 4)

                table.insert(deathLogs, 1, { name = player.Name, cframe = hrp.CFrame, label = label })
                local labels = {}
                for _, entry in ipairs(deathLogs) do table.insert(labels, entry.label) end
                deathDropdown:SetValues(labels)
            end
        end))
    end

    if player.Character then onCharacter(player.Character) end
    table.insert(connections, player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacter))
end

for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do bindCharacterTrackers(player) end
table.insert(connections, Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(bindCharacterTrackers))

PathBox:AddButton('Highlight Evaluated Paths', function()
    for _, hl in ipairs(activePathHighlights) do if hl then hl:Destroy() end end
    table.clear(activePathHighlights)

    local myHRP = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local function evaluateAndHighlight(str)
        if not str or str == "" then return end
        pcall(function()
            local fn = loadstring("return " .. str)
            if fn then
                local res = fn()
                local targets = {}
                if typeof(res) == "Instance" then table.insert(targets, res)
                elseif type(res) == "table" then
                    for _, item in pairs(res) do if typeof(item) == "Instance" then table.insert(targets, item) end end
                end

                for _, target in ipairs(targets) do
                    if target:IsA("BasePart") or target:IsA("Model") then
                        local partToCheck = target:IsA("Model") and target.PrimaryPart or target
                        if partToCheck and myHRP and (partToCheck.Position - myHRP.Position).Magnitude <= pathRangeLimit then
                            local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
                            highlight.Adornee = target
                            highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 0)
                            highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                            highlight.FillTransparency = pathHighlightTransparency
                            highlight.OutlineTransparency = pathHighlightTransparency
                            highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
                            highlight.Parent = customHighlightFolder
                            table.insert(activePathHighlights, highlight)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end
    evaluateAndHighlight(pathInputExpr)
    evaluateAndHighlight(pathInputProp)
    playCustomSound("General")
    Library:Notify("Wall-penetrating highlights applied.", 3)
end)

scripts.features:
FluentHeart's older brother.
[OPEN SOURCE]

Movement
WalkSpeed & JumpPower Sliders: Adjust character movement speed (16–250) and jump height (50–300).

Instant Stop (Disable Sliding): Removes character deceleration so you stop moving immediately when keys are released.

Custom Gravity & Slope Angle: Adjustable gravity control and 360° MaxSlopeAngle toggle to walk up vertical surfaces.

No Void Protection: Lowers the void kill-boundary height so you don't die or get destroyed when falling off the map.

Camera & FOV Controls: Field of view slider (60–120) and extended camera zoom distance slider (up to 12,800 studs).

Float Platform: Spawns an anchored platform beneath your feet with customizable vertical offset and Q/E key controls for moving up and down.

Waypoint System: Save up to 50 custom position waypoints, teleport to saved points, delete waypoints, or TP directly to any active game SpawnLocation.

Position & Axis Tools: One-click copy for current CFrame coordinates to clipboard and snap character facing direction directly North.

Teleport Tool: Equips a click-to-teleport tool in your inventory.

Players & Tracking
Player Teleport: Select any player from a dropdown list to instantly teleport to their location.

Latch Onto Player: Teleports to a chosen player and automatically teleports you back to your starting position once turned off.

Spectate Camera & Beam Tracer: Spectate target player viewports with a visual beam tracer drawing a line between your character and theirs.

Low HP Tracker: Audio alerts and notifications when surrounding players drop below 35 HP.

Death Logger & Teleport: Automatically logs player death coordinates (including void deaths) with timestamps and allows you to teleport to where they died.

Visuals & Rendering
Lighting Adjustments: Fullbright toggle, disable fog, and global shadow toggle.

Potato Graphics: Converts world materials to Smooth Plastic for more FPS on lower-end devices.

Player ESP: Wall-penetrating highlights and Billboard text displaying player names and real-time health (with range, font size, Y-offset, and transparency sliders).

NPC ESP: Separate highlight and text display for non-player humanoids in workspace.

Instance Path Evaluator: Evaluates string expressions or property paths (e.g., workspace.spawn:GetChildren()[1]) and highlights matched parts through walls.

Utilities & Diagnostics
Player Activity Logger: Tracks player leave events and session durations with queued notification popups.

Integrated Script Launchers: One-click execution for UniversalSynSaveInstance and Infinite Yield.

Workspace Scanner: Scans workspace to count anchored parts, unanchored parts, tools, players, and NPCs.

Live Performance Tracker: Monitors real-time FPS, network latency (Ping in ms), and total Memory usage (MB).

Customization & Configurations
Custom UI Keybind: Remap the UI toggle key (default is Right Control).

Sound Customization: Select sound IDs and adjust volumes for Low HP, Player Left, and General UI notifications.

Linoria Config & Theme Manager: Save, load, and auto-load script profiles or customize UI theme colors.

Telemetry & Usage Stats: Optional feature counter that logs script session metrics to the developer console (F9).

scripts.script:
--[[
    Minimal Fly Widget
    Чисто, удобно, без лишнего
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

-- Настройки
local Speed = 50
local Flying = false
local BodyVel, BodyGyro
local Conn
local Vertical = 0          -- -1 down, 0, +1 up
local Keys = {W=false, A=false, S=false, D=false, Space=false, Ctrl=false}

-- GUI Parent
local function getGuiParent()
    if gethui then
        local ok, h = pcall(gethui)
        if ok and h then return h end
    end
    return game:GetService("CoreGui")
end

local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "MinimalFly"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ScreenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
ScreenGui.Parent = getGuiParent()

-- Основной виджет
local Widget = Instance.new("Frame")
Widget.Name = "Widget"
Widget.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(180, 210)
Widget.Position = UDim2.new(0.02, 0, 0.35, 0)
Widget.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 24)
Widget.BorderSizePixel = 0
Widget.Active = true
Widget.Draggable = true
Widget.Parent = ScreenGui

local UICorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
UICorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
UICorner.Parent = Widget

local Stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
Stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 65)
Stroke.Thickness = 1
Stroke.Parent = Widget

-- Заголовок
local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -36, 0, 32)
Title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 6)
Title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Title.Text = "FLY"
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 245)
Title.TextSize = 16
Title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
Title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
Title.Parent = Widget

-- Кнопка закрыть
local CloseBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
CloseBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26)
CloseBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 6)
CloseBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 45)
CloseBtn.Text = "×"
CloseBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 210)
CloseBtn.TextSize = 18
CloseBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
CloseBtn.Parent = Widget

local CloseCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
CloseCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
CloseCorner.Parent = CloseBtn

CloseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    ScreenGui:Destroy()
    if Flying then stopFly() end
end)

-- Скорость
local SpeedLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
SpeedLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 18)
SpeedLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 42)
SpeedLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
SpeedLabel.Text = "Speed"
SpeedLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 160)
SpeedLabel.TextSize = 12
SpeedLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
SpeedLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
SpeedLabel.Parent = Widget

local SpeedBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
SpeedBox.Size = UDim2.new(1, -90, 0, 28)
SpeedBox.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 62)
SpeedBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 38)
SpeedBox.Text = tostring(Speed)
SpeedBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 245)
SpeedBox.TextSize = 14
SpeedBox.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
SpeedBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
SpeedBox.Parent = Widget

local SpeedCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
SpeedCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
SpeedCorner.Parent = SpeedBox

local function updateSpeed(val)
    Speed = math.clamp(tonumber(val) or Speed, 1, 1000)
    SpeedBox.Text = tostring(math.floor(Speed))
end

SpeedBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
    updateSpeed(SpeedBox.Text)
end)

-- Кнопки + / -
local function makeSmallBtn(text, pos)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 28)
    btn.Position = pos
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 55)
    btn.Text = text
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 245)
    btn.TextSize = 16
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    btn.Parent = Widget
    local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
    c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    c.Parent = btn
    return btn
end

local MinusBtn = makeSmallBtn("−", UDim2.new(1, -76, 0, 62))
local PlusBtn  = makeSmallBtn("+", UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 62))

MinusBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    updateSpeed(Speed - 5)
end)
PlusBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    updateSpeed(Speed + 5)
end)

-- Кнопки UP / DOWN
local function makeActionBtn(text, pos, color)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -16, 0, 34)
    btn.Position = pos
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = color or Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 55)
    btn.Text = text
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 250)
    btn.TextSize = 13
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    btn.Parent = Widget
    local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
    c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    c.Parent = btn
    return btn
end

local UpBtn   = makeActionBtn("UP",   UDim2.fromOffset(12, 102), Color3.fromRGB(45, 55, 80))
local DownBtn = makeActionBtn("DOWN", UDim2.new(0.5, 4, 0, 102), Color3.fromRGB(45, 55, 80))

UpBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() Vertical = 1 end)
UpBtn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() Vertical = 0 end)
UpBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() Vertical = 0 end)

DownBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() Vertical = -1 end)
DownBtn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() Vertical = 0 end)
DownBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() Vertical = 0 end)

-- Главная кнопка FLY
local FlyBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
FlyBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 42)
FlyBtn.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 148)
FlyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 90, 220)
FlyBtn.Text = "FLY"
FlyBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
FlyBtn.TextSize = 16
FlyBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
FlyBtn.Parent = Widget

local FlyCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
FlyCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
FlyCorner.Parent = FlyBtn

local function setFlyVisual(state)
    if state then
        FlyBtn.Text = "STOP"
        FlyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 80)
    else
        FlyBtn.Text = "FLY"
        FlyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 90, 220)
    end
end

-- ===== Логика полёта =====
local function getRoot()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    return char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
end

local function stopFly()
    Flying = false
    setFlyVisual(false)
    if Conn then Conn:Disconnect() Conn = nil end
    if BodyVel then BodyVel:Destroy() BodyVel = nil end
    if BodyGyro then BodyGyro:Destroy() BodyGyro = nil end
    local hum = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then
        hum.PlatformStand = false
    end
end

local function startFly()
    local root = getRoot()
    local hum = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not root or not hum then return end

    Flying = true
    setFlyVisual(true)

    BodyVel = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    BodyVel.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
    BodyVel.Velocity = Vector3.zero
    BodyVel.Parent = root

    BodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    BodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
    BodyGyro.P = 9e4
    BodyGyro.Parent = root

    hum.PlatformStand = true

    Conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not Flying or not root or not root.Parent then
            stopFly()
            return
        end

        local camCF = Camera.CFrame
        local move = Vector3.zero

        if Keys.W then move = move + camCF.LookVector end
        if Keys.S then move = move - camCF.LookVector end
        if Keys.A then move = move - camCF.RightVector end
        if Keys.D then move = move + camCF.RightVector end

        -- вертикаль от кнопок + клавиш
        local up = Vertical
        if Keys.Space then up = up + 1 end
        if Keys.Ctrl  then up = up - 1 end

        if move.Magnitude > 0 then
            move = move.Unit * Speed
        end
        move = move + Vector3.new(0, up * Speed, 0)

        BodyVel.Velocity = move
        BodyGyro.CFrame = camCF
    end)
end

local function toggleFly()
    if Flying then
        stopFly()
    else
        startFly()
    end
end

FlyBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleFly)

-- Клавиши
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
    if gp then return end
    local key = input.KeyCode
    if key == Enum.KeyCode.W then Keys.W = true end
    if key == Enum.KeyCode.A then Keys.A = true end
    if key == Enum.KeyCode.S then Keys.S = true end
    if key == Enum.KeyCode.D then Keys.D = true end
    if key == Enum.KeyCode.Space then Keys.Space = true end
    if key == Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl or key == Enum.KeyCode.RightControl then Keys.Ctrl = true end
    if key == Enum.KeyCode.F then toggleFly() end   -- быстрый тогл на F
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    local key = input.KeyCode
    if key == Enum.KeyCode.W then Keys.W = false end
    if key == Enum.KeyCode.A then Keys.A = false end
    if key == Enum.KeyCode.S then Keys.S = false end
    if key == Enum.KeyCode.D then Keys.D = false end
    if key == Enum.KeyCode.Space then Keys.Space = false end
    if key == Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl or key == Enum.KeyCode.RightControl then Keys.Ctrl = false end
end)

-- При респавне выключаем
LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    if Flying then stopFly() end
end)

print("[Minimal Fly] loaded • F = toggle")

local function runDummyScript(f, scri)
	local oldenv = getfenv(f)
	local newenv = setmetatable({}, {
		__index = function(_, k)
			if k:lower() == 'script' then return scri else return oldenv[k] end
		end
	})
	setfenv(f, newenv)
	ypcall(function() f() end)
end

mas.Name = "CompiledModel"

local Tool          = Instance.new("Tool")
local Handle        = Instance.new("Part")
local Mesh          = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")

Tool.Grip = CFrame.new(0.9, -0.01, -0.4) * CFrame.fromOrientation(0, math.rad(-90), math.rad(-90))

Handle.CanCollide = false
Handle.FormFactor = Enum.FormFactor.Custom
Handle.Size = Vector3.new(5, 1, 1)
Handle.CFrame = CFrame.new(787.34, 3.70, 228.68, -1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, -1)

Mesh.Parent = Handle

ToolScript.Name = "ToolScript"
ToolScript.Parent = Tool
table.insert(cors, coroutine.create(function()
	wait()
	runDummyScript(function()
		local SHOT_SPEED = 180
		local SHOT_TIME  = 10
		local MUZZLE_LOCAL_OFFSET = Vector3.new(2.2, 0, 0)
		local EXPLOSION_RADIUS = 12
		local EXPLOSION_SOUND_ID = "rbxassetid://12221984"

		local ROCKET_FORWARD_OFFSET = 1.5
		local MAX_CLICK_RANGE = 500

		local ROCKET_MESH_ID = "rbxassetid://2251534"
		local ROCKET_MESH_SCALE = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
		local ROCKET_COLOR = "Medium stone grey"
		local ROCKET_FIRE_HEAT = 4
		local ROCKET_FIRE_SIZE = 2

		local ROCKET_INITIAL_ARC   = 0.45
		local ROCKET_STEER_P       = 2500
		local ROCKET_STEER_D       = 250
		local ROCKET_DETONATE_DIST = 3.0
		local ROCKET_ARC_MIN_DIST  = 25
		local ROCKET_ARC_FULL_DIST = 90
		local ROCKET_ARM_TIME      = 0.15

		local ROCKET_SLOWDOWN_DIST = 25
		local ROCKET_MIN_SPEED_FRACTION = 0.35
		local ROCKET_CORNER_MIN_SPEED = 0.35

		local WHOOSH_START_VOLUME = 2
		local WHOOSH_FADE_START   = 15
		local WHOOSH_FADE_END     = 220

		-- === OBSTACLE AVOIDANCE ===
		local ROCKET_OBSTACLE_LOOKAHEAD   = 100
		local ROCKET_OBSTACLE_AVOID_PULL  = 3.2
		local ROCKET_AVOID_BLEND          = 0.85
		local ROCKET_AVOID_STICKY_TIME    = 0.60
		local ROCKET_AVOID_RAMP_EXP       = 0.45

		local ROCKET_MAX_LEAD_TIME = 0.75
		local ROCKET_MIN_LEAD_SPEED = 2

		local ROCKET_TERMINAL_LOCK_DIST = 30
		local ROCKET_OVERSHOOT_DIST = 12

		-- === EXPLOSION TUNING ===
		local EXPLOSION_BLAST_PRESSURE   = 0     -- Keeps explosion visual & instance active, but strips out default engine kill force
		local BLAST_KNOCKBACK_STRENGTH   = 250   
		local NPC_KNOCKBACK_STRENGTH     = 110   

		local PlayersService     = Game:GetService('Players')
		local DebrisService      = Game:GetService('Debris')
		local RunService         = Game:GetService('RunService')
		local SoundService       = Game:GetService('SoundService')
		local UserInputService   = Game:GetService('UserInputService')

		local Workspace = workspace
		local LocalPlayer = PlayersService.LocalPlayer

		local Tool = script.Parent
		local Handle = Tool:WaitForChild('Handle')
		local ReloadSound = Handle:WaitForChild('Reload')

		local Character, Humanoid, Player = nil, nil, nil
		local BaseShot = nil

		local ActiveShot     = nil
		local ActiveWhoosh   = nil
		local ActiveUpdateConn = nil

		local function cleanupActive()
			if ActiveUpdateConn then
				ActiveUpdateConn:Disconnect()
				ActiveUpdateConn = nil
			end
			if ActiveWhoosh then
				ActiveWhoosh:Stop()
				ActiveWhoosh:Destroy()
				ActiveWhoosh = nil
			end
			if ActiveShot then
				ActiveShot = nil
			end
		end

		local function playAtPosition(soundId, position, volume, pitch)
			local anchor = Instance.new("Part")
			anchor.Anchored = true
			anchor.CanCollide = false
			anchor.Transparency = 1
			anchor.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
			anchor.CFrame = CFrame.new(position)
			anchor.Parent = Workspace

			local s = Instance.new("Sound")
			s.SoundId = soundId
			s.Volume = volume or 2
			s.Pitch = pitch or 1
			s.RollOffMaxDistance = 500
			s.RollOffMinDistance = 5
			s.RollOffMode = Enum.RollOffMode.InverseTapered
			s.Parent = anchor

			s:Play()
			DebrisService:AddItem(anchor, 5)
		end

		local function WeOwnCharacter(character)
			if not character or not character.Parent then return false end
			local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				or character.PrimaryPart
			if not root then return false end
			local owner = nil
			pcall(function() owner = root:GetNetworkOwner() end)
			return owner == LocalPlayer
		end

		local function TryTakeOwnership(character)
			if not character or not character.Parent then return false end
			local gotAny = false
			for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") then
					local ok = pcall(function()
						part:SetNetworkOwner(LocalPlayer)
					end)
					if ok then gotAny = true end
				end
			end
			return gotAny
		end

		local function ApplyDamageStack(humanoid, damage)
			if not humanoid or not humanoid.Parent then return end
			if damage and damage > 0 then
				pcall(function() humanoid:TakeDamage(damage) end)
			end
			if not damage then
				pcall(function() humanoid.Health = -1 end)
				pcall(function() humanoid:TakeDamage(9999999999) end)
			elseif humanoid.Health > 0 and damage >= 9999999 then
				pcall(function() humanoid.Health = -1 end)
				pcall(function() humanoid:TakeDamage(9999999999) end)
			end
		end

		local function ReliableKill(character, humanoid)
			task.spawn(function()
				ApplyDamageStack(humanoid)

				if humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end

				for _ = 1, 20 do
					if not character.Parent or not humanoid.Parent then return end
					if humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end

					if not WeOwnCharacter(character) then
						TryTakeOwnership(character)
					end
					ApplyDamageStack(humanoid)
					task.wait(0.1)
				end
			end)
		end

		local EXPLOSION_DAMAGE_BANDS = {
			{0.50, 9999999},
			{0.58, 0.90},
			{0.67, 0.70},
			{0.75, 0.50},
			{0.83, 0.35},
			{0.92, 0.20},
			{1.00, 0.10},
		}

		local function damageFractionForRatio(ratio)
			for _, band in ipairs(EXPLOSION_DAMAGE_BANDS) do
				if ratio <= band[1] then
					return band[2]
				end
			end
			return 0
		end

		local function isPlayerCharacter(char)
			if not char then return false end
			local ok, plr = pcall(function()
				return PlayersService:GetPlayerFromCharacter(char)
			end)
			return ok and plr ~= nil
		end

		local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
		overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {}

		local function applyExplosion(pos)
			local radius   = EXPLOSION_RADIUS
			local propKb   = BLAST_KNOCKBACK_STRENGTH
			local npcKb    = NPC_KNOCKBACK_STRENGTH

			local parts = Workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(pos, radius, overlapParams)
			local seenChars = {}

			for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
				local char = nil
				local node = part
				for _ = 1, 4 do
					if not node or node == Workspace then break end
					node = node.Parent
					if node and node:IsA("Model")
						and node:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
						char = node
						break
					end
				end

				if char then
					if not seenChars[char] then
						seenChars[char] = true

						local hum  = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
						local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

						if hum and root and hum.Health > 0
							and char ~= Character
							and not isPlayerCharacter(char) then

							local d = (root.Position - pos).Magnitude
							if d <= radius then

								if not root.Anchored then
									local delta = root.Position - pos
									local dir
									if delta.Magnitude < 0.01 then
										dir = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
									else
										dir = delta.Unit
									end
									dir = (dir + Vector3.new(0, 0.55, 0)).Unit

									local falloff = 1 - (d / radius)
									local mass = root:GetMass()
									local impulse = dir * (npcKb * falloff) * mass

									pcall(function()
										root:ApplyImpulse(impulse)
									end)
								end

								local frac = damageFractionForRatio(d / radius)

								if frac > 1 then
									ReliableKill(char, hum)
								else
									local damage =
										(hum.MaxHealth > 0 and hum.MaxHealth or 100) * frac

									task.spawn(function()
										if not WeOwnCharacter(char) then
											for _ = 1, 5 do
												if not char.Parent or not hum.Parent
													or hum.Health <= 0 then return end
												TryTakeOwnership(char)
												if WeOwnCharacter(char) then break end
												task.wait(0.05)
											end
										end

										if not char.Parent or not hum.Parent then return end
										if hum.Health <= 0 then return end

										ApplyDamageStack(hum, damage)
									end)
								end
							end
						end
					end
				elseif part:IsA("BasePart") and not part.Anchored then
					local delta = part.Position - pos
					local d = delta.Magnitude
					if d <= radius and d > 0.01 then
						local falloff = 1 - (d / radius)
						local mass = part:GetMass()
						local impulse = delta.Unit * (propKb * falloff) * mass
						pcall(function() part:ApplyImpulse(impulse) end)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		local function killSounds(part)
			if not part then return end
			for _, child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
				if child:IsA("Sound") then
					child.Looped = false
					child:Stop()
					child:Destroy()
				end
			end
		end

		local shotTargets = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})

		local function OnTouched(shot, otherPart, detonatePosition)
			if not shot or not shot.Parent then return end
			if shot:GetAttribute("Hit") then return end

			if otherPart then
				if not shot:GetAttribute("Armed") then
					local tgt = shotTargets[shot]
					if not (tgt and otherPart:IsDescendantOf(tgt)) then
						return
					end
				end
				local allowSelf = shot:GetAttribute("AllowSelfHit") == true
				if (not allowSelf) and Character and otherPart:IsDescendantOf(Character) then
					return
				end
			end

			shot:SetAttribute("Hit", true)

			local pos = detonatePosition or shot.Position

			cleanupActive()
			killSounds(shot)
			shot:Destroy()

			-- Spawns the standard visual explosion object, but with 0 blast pressure so your custom damage bands handle the kills safely
			local explosion = Instance.new("Explosion")
			explosion.BlastRadius = EXPLOSION_RADIUS
			explosion.BlastPressure = EXPLOSION_BLAST_PRESSURE
			explosion.DestroyJointRadiusPercent = 0
			explosion.Position = pos
			explosion.Parent = Workspace

			applyExplosion(pos)

			playAtPosition(EXPLOSION_SOUND_ID, pos, 2.5, 1)
		end

		local function OnEquipped()
			Character = Tool.Parent
			Humanoid = Character:WaitForChild('Humanoid')
			Player = PlayersService:GetPlayerFromCharacter(Character)
		end

		local function nozzleCFrame(position, forward)
			forward = forward.Magnitude > 1e-4 and forward.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)

			local upRef = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
			if math.abs(forward:Dot(upRef)) > 0.99 then
				upRef = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
			end

			local vZ = -forward
			local vY = (upRef - vZ * vZ:Dot(upRef)).Unit
			local vX = vY:Cross(vZ)
			return CFrame.fromMatrix(position, vX, vY, vZ)
		end

		local function closestPointOnSegment(A, B, P)
			local ab = B - A
			local abLen2 = ab:Dot(ab)
			if abLen2 < 1e-6 then
				return (P - A).Magnitude, A
			end
			local t = (P - A):Dot(ab) / abLen2
			t = math.clamp(t, 0, 1)
			local closest = A + ab * t
			return (P - closest).Magnitude, closest
		end

		local function findClickTarget()
			local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
			if not camera then
				return { staticPosition = Humanoid and Humanoid.TargetPoint or Vector3.new() }
			end

			local mouseLocation = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
			local ray = camera:ViewportPointToRay(mouseLocation.X, mouseLocation.Y)

			local params = RaycastParams.new()
			params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			local excludeList = {}
			if Handle then table.insert(excludeList, Handle) end
			if ActiveShot then table.insert(excludeList, ActiveShot) end
			params.FilterDescendantsInstances = excludeList

			local result = Workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin, ray.Direction * MAX_CLICK_RANGE, params)

			if not result then
				local fallback = Humanoid and Humanoid.TargetPoint or (ray.Origin + ray.Direction * 100)
				return { staticPosition = fallback }
			end

			local hitPart = result.Instance

			local currentModel = hitPart:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
			while currentModel do
				local modelHumanoid = currentModel:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				local rootPart = currentModel:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					or (modelHumanoid and modelHumanoid.RootPart)
					or (modelHumanoid and modelHumanoid.Torso)

				if modelHumanoid or rootPart then
					return {
						npc            = currentModel,
						humanoid       = modelHumanoid,
						rootPart       = rootPart or hitPart,
						hitPosition    = result.Position,
						staticPosition = result.Position,
					}
				end

				currentModel = currentModel:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
			end

			return {
				staticPosition = result.Position,
				hitPart        = hitPart,
			}
		end

		local function shouldDodgeObstacle(hitPart)
			local node = hitPart
			local topModel = nil
			for _ = 1, 6 do
				if not node or node == Workspace then break end
				if node:IsA("Model") then
					if node:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
						return false
					end
					topModel = node
				end
				node = node.Parent
			end

			local size
			if topModel then
				local ok, bbox = pcall(function()
					return topModel:GetExtentsSize()
				end)
				if ok and bbox then
					size = bbox
				end
			end
			if not size then
				size = hitPart.Size
			end

			local axes = {size.X, size.Y, size.Z}
			table.sort(axes)
			if axes[1] < 3 and axes[2] < 3 then
				return false
			end

			return true
		end

		local function findAvoidanceDir(origin, desiredDir, params, maxLen)
			local lookLen = math.min(ROCKET_OBSTACLE_LOOKAHEAD, maxLen or ROCKET_OBSTACLE_LOOKAHEAD)

			local hit = Workspace:Raycast(origin, desiredDir * lookLen, params)
			if not hit then return nil, 0 end

			if not shouldDodgeObstacle(hit.Instance) then
				return nil, 0
			end

			local hitDist = (hit.Position - origin).Magnitude
			local strength = math.clamp(1 - (hitDist / lookLen), 0, 1)
			strength = strength ^ ROCKET_AVOID_RAMP_EXP

			local up = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
			if math.abs(desiredDir:Dot(up)) > 0.95 then
				up = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
			end
			local right = desiredDir:Cross(up).Unit
			local left = -right
			local down = -up

			local candidates = {
				right, left,
				(right + up).Unit,   (left + up).Unit,
				(right + down).Unit, (left + down).Unit,
				up, down,
			}
			local bestDir, bestScore = nil, -math.huge

			for _, side in ipairs(candidates) do
				local candidate = (desiredDir + side * ROCKET_OBSTACLE_AVOID_PULL).Unit
				local test = Workspace:Raycast(origin, candidate * lookLen, params)
				local clearance
				if test then
					clearance = (test.Position - origin).Magnitude
				else
					clearance = lookLen
				end
				local score = clearance + candidate:Dot(desiredDir) * 6
				if candidate.Y < -0.3 then
					score = score - 8
				end
				if score > bestScore then
					bestScore, bestDir = score, candidate
				end
			end

			return bestDir, strength
		end

		local function OnActivated()
			if Tool.Enabled and Humanoid.Health > 0 then
				Tool.Enabled = false

				cleanupActive()

				local handleCFrame = Handle.CFrame
				local firingPoint = handleCFrame:PointToWorldSpace(MUZZLE_LOCAL_OFFSET)

				local clickTarget = findClickTarget()

				local initialTargetPos
				if clickTarget.npc and clickTarget.rootPart and clickTarget.rootPart.Parent then
					initialTargetPos = clickTarget.rootPart.Position
				else
					initialTargetPos = clickTarget.staticPosition
				end

				local aimVec = initialTargetPos - firingPoint
				if aimVec.Magnitude < 1e-3 then
					aimVec = handleCFrame.lookVector * 100
					initialTargetPos = firingPoint + aimVec
				end

				local targetDistance = (initialTargetPos - firingPoint).Magnitude

				local arcAmount = 0
				if targetDistance > ROCKET_ARC_MIN_DIST then
					local t = math.clamp(
						(targetDistance - ROCKET_ARC_MIN_DIST) /
						(ROCKET_ARC_FULL_DIST - ROCKET_ARC_MIN_DIST),
						0, 1)
					arcAmount = ROCKET_INITIAL_ARC * t
				end

				local initialForward = (aimVec.Unit + Vector3.new(0, arcAmount, 0)).Unit

				local shot = BaseShot:Clone()
				local initialCF = nozzleCFrame(firingPoint + initialForward * ROCKET_FORWARD_OFFSET, initialForward)
				shot.CFrame = initialCF
				ActiveShot = shot

				if clickTarget.npc then
					shotTargets[shot] = clickTarget.npc
				end
				task.delay(ROCKET_ARM_TIME, function()
					if shot and shot.Parent then
						shot:SetAttribute("Armed", true)
					end
				end)

				local isSelfTarget = (clickTarget.npc ~= nil and clickTarget.npc == Character)
				if isSelfTarget then
					shot:SetAttribute("AllowSelfHit", true)
				end

				local targetPart = nil
				if clickTarget.npc and clickTarget.rootPart and clickTarget.rootPart.Parent then
					targetPart = clickTarget.rootPart
				end

				local whoosh = Instance.new("Sound")
				whoosh.Name = "RocketWhoosh"
				whoosh.SoundId = "rbxasset://sounds/Rocket whoosh 01.wav"
				whoosh.Looped = true
				whoosh.Volume = WHOOSH_START_VOLUME
				whoosh.Parent = SoundService
				ActiveWhoosh = whoosh

				local gyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
				gyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
				gyro.P = ROCKET_STEER_P
				gyro.D = ROCKET_STEER_D
				gyro.CFrame = initialCF
				gyro.Parent = shot

				local bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
				bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
				bodyVelocity.Velocity = initialForward * SHOT_SPEED
				bodyVelocity.Parent = shot

				local lastPos = shot.Position
				local committedAvoidDir, committedAvoidUntil = nil, 0
				local terminalLock = false

				local ignoreList = {shot, Handle}
				if Character then table.insert(ignoreList, Character) end
				if clickTarget.npc then table.insert(ignoreList, clickTarget.npc) end

				local avoidParams = RaycastParams.new()
				avoidParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
				avoidParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignoreList
				avoidParams.IgnoreWater = true

				local updateConn
				updateConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
					if not shot or not shot.Parent then
						if updateConn then updateConn:Disconnect() end
						return
					end

					local liveTargetPos
					if targetPart and targetPart.Parent then
						liveTargetPos = targetPart.Position
					else
						liveTargetPos = clickTarget.staticPosition
					end

					local currentPos = shot.Position
					local distToTarget = (liveTargetPos - currentPos).Magnitude

					local closestDist, closestPt = closestPointOnSegment(lastPos, currentPos, liveTargetPos)
					if closestDist <= ROCKET_DETONATE_DIST then
						OnTouched(shot, nil, closestPt)
						return
					end

					if not terminalLock and distToTarget <= ROCKET_TERMINAL_LOCK_DIST then
						terminalLock = true
					end

					if terminalLock then
						local lockVec = liveTargetPos - currentPos
						if lockVec.Magnitude > 0.01 then
							local dir = lockVec.Unit

							local forwardDot = dir:Dot(shot.CFrame.LookVector)
							if forwardDot < -0.5 and distToTarget < ROCKET_OVERSHOOT_DIST then
								OnTouched(shot, nil, currentPos)
								return
							end

							gyro.CFrame = CFrame.new(currentPos, currentPos + dir)
							bodyVelocity.Velocity = dir * SHOT_SPEED
						else
							OnTouched(shot, nil, currentPos)
							return
						end
					else
						local steerTargetPos = liveTargetPos
						local toTargetSteer = steerTargetPos - currentPos
						local finalDir = shot.CFrame.LookVector

						if toTargetSteer.Magnitude > 0.5 then
							local desiredDir = toTargetSteer.Unit
							finalDir = desiredDir

							local probeLen = math.min(
								ROCKET_OBSTACLE_LOOKAHEAD,
								math.max(0, distToTarget - 4))

							if probeLen >= 5 then
								local blend = 0

								if committedAvoidDir and os.clock() < committedAvoidUntil then
									local probe = Workspace:Raycast(
										currentPos,
										desiredDir * probeLen,
										avoidParams)
									if probe and shouldDodgeObstacle(probe.Instance) then
										local d = (probe.Position - currentPos).Magnitude
										local s = math.clamp(1 - (d / probeLen), 0, 1)
										blend = ROCKET_AVOID_BLEND * (s ^ ROCKET_AVOID_RAMP_EXP)
									elseif probe then
										committedAvoidDir = nil
										blend = 0
									else
										blend = ROCKET_AVOID_BLEND
									end
									if blend > 0 then
										finalDir = (desiredDir * (1 - blend)
											+ committedAvoidDir * blend).Unit
									end
								else
									local avoidDir, avoidStrength =
										findAvoidanceDir(currentPos, desiredDir, avoidParams, probeLen)
									if avoidDir then
										committedAvoidDir = avoidDir
										committedAvoidUntil = os.clock() + ROCKET_AVOID_STICKY_TIME
										blend = ROCKET_AVOID_BLEND * avoidStrength
										finalDir = (desiredDir * (1 - blend)
											+ avoidDir * blend).Unit
									else
										committedAvoidDir = nil
									end
								end
							else
								committedAvoidDir = nil
							end

							gyro.CFrame = CFrame.new(currentPos, currentPos + finalDir)
						end

						local speed = SHOT_SPEED
						if distToTarget < ROCKET_SLOWDOWN_DIST then
							local t = distToTarget / ROCKET_SLOWDOWN_DIST
							speed = SHOT_SPEED * math.max(ROCKET_MIN_SPEED_FRACTION, t)
						end

						local curForward = shot.CFrame.LookVector
						local alignment = math.clamp(curForward:Dot(finalDir), 0, 1)
						local cornerFactor = ROCKET_CORNER_MIN_SPEED
							+ (1 - ROCKET_CORNER_MIN_SPEED) * alignment
						speed = speed * cornerFactor

						bodyVelocity.Velocity = curForward * speed
					end

					lastPos = currentPos

					if whoosh and whoosh.Parent then
						local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
						if cam then
							local dist = (currentPos - cam.CFrame.Position).Magnitude
							local alpha
							if dist <= WHOOSH_FADE_START then
								alpha = 1
							elseif dist >= WHOOSH_FADE_END then
								alpha = 0
							else
								alpha = 1 - ((dist - WHOOSH_FADE_START) / (WHOOSH_FADE_END - WHOOSH_FADE_START))
							end
							whoosh.Volume = WHOOSH_START_VOLUME * alpha
							if alpha <= 0 then
								whoosh:Stop()
							end
						end
					end
				end)
				ActiveUpdateConn = updateConn

				shot.Destroying:Connect(function()
					if updateConn then updateConn:Disconnect() end
					if ActiveUpdateConn == updateConn then ActiveUpdateConn = nil end
					if whoosh then
						whoosh:Stop()
						whoosh:Destroy()
						if ActiveWhoosh == whoosh then ActiveWhoosh = nil end
					end
				end)

				whoosh:Play()

				shot.Touched:Connect(function(otherPart)
					OnTouched(shot, otherPart)
				end)
				DebrisService:AddItem(shot, SHOT_TIME)
				shot.Parent = Tool

				task.delay(SHOT_TIME + 0.1, function()
					if ActiveShot == shot then
						cleanupActive()
					end
				end)

				wait(0)
				ReloadSound:Play()
				wait(2)
				Tool.Enabled = true
			end
		end

		BaseShot = Instance.new('Part')
		BaseShot.Name = 'Rocket'
		BaseShot.FormFactor = Enum.FormFactor.Custom
		BaseShot.Shape = Enum.PartType.Block
		BaseShot.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)

		Tool.Equipped:Connect(OnEquipped)

end))

local tabs = {}

local showingOutput = false
local MAX_TABS = 10
local PINK = Color3.fromRGB(235, 64, 120)

local function getNextTabNumber()
	local used = {}
	for _, t in ipairs(tabs) do used[t.number] = true end
	for i = 1, MAX_TABS do
		if not used[i] then return i end
	end
	return nil
end

local function updateLineNumbers(textBox)
	local lines = 1
	for _ in textBox.Text:gmatch("\n") do lines = lines + 1 end
	local str = ""
	for i = 1, math.max(lines, 1) do str = str .. i .. "\n" end
	LineNumbers.Text = str
end

local function showExecutorView()

	SubTabBar.Visible = true

	ExecutorTab.TextColor3 = PINK
	if currentTab then
		for _, t in ipairs(tabs) do
			t.textBox.Visible = false
			t.frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
			t.label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
		end
		currentTab.textBox.Visible = true
		currentTab.frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35)
		currentTab.label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 230)
		updateLineNumbers(currentTab.textBox)
	end
end

local function showOutputView()
	showingOutput = true
	OutputContainer.Visible = true
	SubTabBar.Visible = false
	OutputTab.TextColor3 = PINK
	ExecutorTab.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
	LineNumbers.Text = ""
	for _, t in ipairs(tabs) do t.textBox.Visible = false end
end

local function switchToTab(tab)
	showExecutorView()
	for _, t in ipairs(tabs) do
		t.textBox.Visible = false
		t.frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
		t.label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
	end
	tab.textBox.Visible = true
	tab.frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35)
	tab.label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 230)
	currentTab = tab
	updateLineNumbers(tab.textBox)
end

local function closeTab(tab)
	if #tabs <= 1 then return end
	local idx
	for i, t in ipairs(tabs) do if t == tab then idx = i break end end
	if not idx then return end
	tab.frame:Destroy()
	tab.textBox:Destroy()
	table.remove(tabs, idx)
	if currentTab == tab then switchToTab(tabs[math.min(idx, #tabs)]) end
end

local function createTab()
	if #tabs >= MAX_TABS then return end
	local num = getNextTabNumber()
	if not num then return end
	local tab = { number = num }

	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Parent = TabsContainer
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35)
	frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 65, 0, 18)
	tab.frame = frame

	local label = Instance.new("TextButton")
	label.Parent = frame
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 0)
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, 0)
	label.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
	label.Text = "Tab " .. num
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 230)
	label.TextSize = 12
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	tab.label = label

	local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	closeBtn.Parent = frame
	closeBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0, 0)
	closeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 12, 1, 0)
	closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
	closeBtn.Text = "x"
	closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)
	closeBtn.TextSize = 11
	closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() closeTab(tab) end)

	local textBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
	textBox.Parent = EditorContainer
	textBox.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	textBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 5)
	textBox.Size = UDim2.new(1, -35, 1, -10)
	textBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
	textBox.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	textBox.MultiLine = true
	textBox.Text = ""
	textBox.TextColor3 = PINK
	textBox.TextSize = 14
	textBox.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	textBox.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
	textBox.Visible = false
	tab.textBox = textBox

	textBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
		if currentTab == tab then updateLineNumbers(textBox) end
	end)

	label.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() switchToTab(tab) end)
	table.insert(tabs, tab)
	switchToTab(tab)
	return tab
end

local function runCode(code)
	if not code or code == "" or code:match("^%s*$") then return end
	local chunk, err = loadstring(code)
	if chunk then
		local ok, msg = pcall(chunk)
		if not ok then warn("Błąd wykonania: " .. tostring(msg)) end
	else
		warn("Błąd składni: " .. tostring(err))
	end

	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = text
	label.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	label.TextSize = 13
	label.TextColor3 = color or Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.TextWrapped = true
	label.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	task.defer(function()

		OutputContainer.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, OutputContainer.CanvasSize.Y.Offset)
	end)
end

	local color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
	if messageType == Enum.MessageType.MessageWarning then color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 50)
	elseif messageType == Enum.MessageType.MessageError then color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
	elseif messageType == Enum.MessageType.MessageInfo then color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 180, 255) end
	addLog(message, color)
end)

task.spawn(function()
	IntroSound:Play()

	-- Fade In Títulos
	TweenService:Create(IntroTitle, TweenInfo.new(1), {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
	task.wait(0.4)
	TweenService:Create(IntroSubTitle, TweenInfo.new(1), {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
	task.wait(0.6)

	-- Animação de Carregamento Longa (6 Segundos)
	local duration = 6.0
	local startTime = tick()

	while tick() - startTime < duration do
		local alpha = (tick() - startTime) / duration
		ProgressBarFill.Size = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 1, 0)

		local percent = math.floor(alpha * 100)
		if percent < 25 then
			StatusText.Text = "Carregando Módulos... " .. percent .. "%"
		elseif percent < 50 then
			StatusText.Text = "Verificando Permissões e Segurança... " .. percent .. "%"
		elseif percent < 80 then
			StatusText.Text = "Sincronizando Ferramentas & Target... " .. percent .. "%"
		else
			StatusText.Text = "Finalizando Configurações... " .. percent .. "%"
		end

		RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
	end

	ProgressBarFill.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	StatusText.Text = "Pronto! 100%"
	task.wait(0.6)

	-- Fade Out da Música e da Interface
	TweenService:Create(IntroSound, TweenInfo.new(0.8), {Volume = 0}):Play()

	local fadeInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.8, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	TweenService:Create(LoadingFrame, fadeInfo, {Size = UDim2.new(0, 400, 0, 240), BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()

	TweenService:Create(ProgressBarFill, fadeInfo, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()

	task.wait(0.8)

	-- Exibe o Hub Principal

local function executeFling()

	if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end

	local hrp = char.HumanoidRootPart
	local targetHrp = selectedTarget.Character.HumanoidRootPart

	local oldCFrame = hrp.CFrame
	local startTime = tick()

	local BodyAngularVelocity = Instance.new("BodyAngularVelocity")
	BodyAngularVelocity.AngularVelocity = Vector3.new(99999, 99999, 99999)

	BodyAngularVelocity.P = 125000

	local renderConn
	renderConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if tick() - startTime < 2 and selectedTarget and selectedTarget.Character and selectedTarget.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
			hrp.CFrame = targetHrp.CFrame

	end

	if isSeated or hasNoCollision then
		showNotificationModal("O alvo não tem colisão ou está sentado, deseja executar o arremesso mesmo assim?", function()

local function getNearestPlayer()
	local closestPlayer = nil
	local shortestDistance = math.huge

	local localChar = LocalPlayer.Character
	if not localChar or not localChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return nil end

	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
			if checkTeamFilter and p.Team == LocalPlayer.Team then
				continue
			end

			local dist = (p.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position - localChar.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
			if dist < shortestDistance then
				shortestDistance = dist
				closestPlayer = p
			end
		end
	end
	return closestPlayer
end

				Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position, targetPos)
			end
		end)
	else
		if aimbotNearestConnection then aimbotNearestConnection:Disconnect() end
	end
end)

scripts.script:
-- Скрипт для Аста Корона FE (Fire Emblem)
-- Улучшенная версия с авто-фармом и управлением

local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

-- Настройки
local Settings = {
    AutoFarm = true,
    AutoSwing = true,
    SwingDelay = 0.5,
    TargetRadius = 30,
    ShowESP = true
}

-- Функция для поиска врагов
local function findTargets()
    local targets = {}
    for _, enemy in ipairs(workspace.Enemies:GetChildren()) do
        if enemy:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and enemy.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
            local distance = (enemy.HumanoidRootPart.Position - rootPart.Position).Magnitude
            if distance <= Settings.TargetRadius then
                table.insert(targets, enemy)
            end
        end
    end
    return targets
end

-- Функция атаки
local function attack(target)
    if not target then return end
    
    local sword = character:FindFirstChild("Sword") or character:FindFirstChild("Katana")
    if sword and sword:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
        sword.Handle.CFrame = target.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
        sword:Activate()
    end
end

-- Функция для ESP
local function createESP(enemy)
    if not Settings.ShowESP then return end
    
    local esp = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    esp.Name = "ESP"
    esp.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 50)
    esp.AlwaysOnTop = true
    
    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
    label.Text = enemy.Name
    label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    label.TextSize = 14
    label.Parent = esp
    
    esp.Parent = enemy.Character or enemy
end

-- Основной цикл
spawn(function()
    while true do
        if Settings.AutoFarm then
            local targets = findTargets()
            if #targets > 0 then
                local nearest = targets[1]
                local minDist = math.huge
                
                for _, target in ipairs(targets) do
                    local dist = (target.HumanoidRootPart.Position - rootPart.Position).Magnitude
                    if dist < minDist then
                        minDist = dist
                        nearest = target
                    end
                end
                
                if nearest then
                    attack(nearest)
                end
            end
        end
        
        wait(Settings.SwingDelay)
    end
end)

-- GUI
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Parent = player.PlayerGui

local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 100)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
frame.Parent = screenGui

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "Аст Корона FE"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextSize = 18
title.Parent = frame

local toggleButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
toggleButton.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 30)
toggleButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.35, 0)
toggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 1, 0)
toggleButton.Text = "Авто-фарм: ВКЛ"
toggleButton.TextColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
toggleButton.Parent = frame

toggleButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    Settings.AutoFarm = not Settings.AutoFarm
    toggleButton.Text = Settings.AutoFarm and "Авто-фарм: ВКЛ" or "Авто-фарм: ВЫКЛ"
    toggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Settings.AutoFarm and Color3.new(0, 1, 0) or Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
end)

-- Создание ESP для существующих врагов
for _, enemy in ipairs(workspace.Enemies:GetChildren()) do
    createESP(enemy)
end

workspace.Enemies.ChildAdded:Connect(function(enemy)

lastSend >= CFG.sendRate then lastSend = now remote:FireServer(headSmooth, rootCF * hands.L.cf, rootCF * hands.R.cf) end if S.hud then local pl, onL = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(rootCF:PointToWorldSpace(hands.L.pos)) local pr, onR = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(rootCF:PointToWorldSpace(hands.R.pos)) markerL.Visible = onL markerR.Visible = onR markerL.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(pl.X, pl.Y) markerR.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(pr.X, pr.Y) markerL.BackgroundTransparency = activeL and 0.2 or 0.7 markerR.BackgroundTransparency = activeR and 0.2 or 0.7 else markerL.Visible = false markerR.Visible = false end end) local ncAcc = 0 bind(RunService.Stepped, function(_, dt) applyJoints() if S.noclip then ncAcc = ncAcc + dt if ncAcc >= 0.1 then ncAcc = 0 for _, other in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do if other ~= plr and other.Character then for _, p in ipairs(other.Character:GetChildren()) do if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.CanCollide = false end end end end end end end) shared.NexusVRPC_Cleanup = function() for _, c in ipairs(conns) do c:Disconnect() end CAS:UnbindAction("NexusVRPC_Wheel") S.enabled = false resetJoints() if gui then gui:Destroy() end shared.NexusVRPC_Cleanup = nil end refreshStatus() notify("Nexus VR PC listo · H para ayuda")
